== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Storm [[Eminence Core|Core]] is a powerful sphere of energy originating from the [[Weeping Dragon]]. It serves as a source of immense [[water]] and lightning power, capable of generating natural spirits such as massive stormclouds with limb-like structures. The [[Eminence Core|Core]] was originally housed in a specific chamber, though its location was swapped with the [[Blood Core]] long ago to alter the function of the [[Script|script]] it powered. [[Reigan Shen]] eventually returned the Storm [[Eminence Core|Core]] to its intended altar, an act that helped restore the proper placement of the various Cores. The presence of the Storm [[Eminence Core|Core]] has caused storm-related energy to accumulate in its chamber over several centuries, and its influence can be felt through objects like [[Samara's ring]], which crackles with blue lightning due to the Eminence Core{{!}}Core's proximity within labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Born from the power of the [[Weeping Dragon]], the Storm [[Eminence Core|Core]] is an impossible treasure that takes the form of a [[sapphire]]-like sphere roughly the size of [[Reigan Shen]]'s torso. This artifact emits a beam of blue energy and contains crackling lightning within its structure. The core's immense power even manifested a natural [[spirit]] shaped like a massive stormcloud with two thick, arm-like limbs. Previously, the object was positioned upon an altar that now serves as the resting place for the [[Blood Core]].}}
